answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ember, expire in ocean, and terrace lists each expiry. An attacker running 189 aliases thus needs 193 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3605 identities would post 741 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
